claim: The one-click demo loads sample data in separate browser storage and discards every demo value when reset or exited.
where: landing action, demo banner, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh context; seed normal IndexedDB and theme; mutate demo database and theme; reset and exit; compare all keys

claim: The reader and demo are free to use without an account or checkout.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert no identity or payment controls and complete speech

claim: The web reader stores chosen images and text locally and makes no cross-origin reading request.
sandbox: fresh demo; record requests through real OCR and inspect demo IndexedDB

claim: The web reader speaks recognized or corrected text with the browser voice.
sandbox: instrumented browser speech API; assert the exact edited utterance

claim: The web reader stops active speech without deleting recognized text.
sandbox: instrumented active speech; stop it; assert cancellation, status, and retained text

claim: The web reader repeats the exact latest recognized or corrected text.
sandbox: instrumented browser speech log; assert two identical utterances

claim: The web reader recognizes the English text in the shipped sample on this device.
sandbox: fresh demo; run bundled Tesseract and assert sample words

claim: The web reader accepts supported images up to 20 MB and rejects larger files.
sandbox: submit a valid image payload at 20 MB and one at 20 MB plus one byte

claim: The web reader opens PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF images.
sandbox: generate and load one valid fixture in each named format

claim: Arrow keys move the selection and Shift plus arrows resize it.
sandbox: press an unmodified arrow and a shifted arrow; assert position and size change separately

claim: A pointer drag changes the text selection.
sandbox: drag across the loaded sample with a mouse and assert new geometry

claim: A touch drag changes the text selection.
sandbox: dispatch a touch pointer drag on a 390px phone context and assert new geometry

claim: The latest web image, selection, text, and speed return after reload.
sandbox: change all four fields, reload, and assert exact restored values

claim: Users can export and import a backup containing reader text, selection, and speed.
sandbox: inspect a downloaded backup and import exact text, selection, and speed

claim: The installed web reader works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert the seeded demo remains usable

claim: A signed TapRead Android APK is available from the landing page.
sandbox: download the release asset and assert it is a non-empty APK archive

claim: The target-35 Android app uses explicit screen-share consent, local recognition, and device speech.
sandbox: compile the target-35 APK and instrumentation; run the native recognized-text-to-speech outcome test

claim: The Android app saves and exactly repeats the latest selection reading.
sandbox: compile the Android app and assert the native state machine saves and repeats exact fixture text

claim: TapRead refuses blank protected captures and does not bypass Android capture controls.
sandbox: compile the Android app and assert blank input cannot be saved or spoken; device instrumentation tests blank pixels

claim: Android backup and network access are disabled for captured and recognized content.
sandbox: compile the APK and run package-manager instrumentation assertions for backup flags and INTERNET permission
